title: ks.state: versioned object store
outcome: SQLite-backed versioned store per ADR-05: get -> (value, ver, author), history(obj), put with before/after versions
acceptance: put/get/history round-trip with monotonic ver per object; put returns WriteEntry before/after ver+hash matching contracts C3
put raises if a row value carries a sensitive key (each datum in exactly one object); field create/delete writes/tombstones field objects (test_sensitive_field_object)
test_field_only_update_keeps_row_ver passes; store runs inside a caller-owned BEGIN IMMEDIATE txn
summary: src/ks/state/: SQLite versioned store per ADR-05 §1-2. objects(head) + append-only versions (UPDATE/DELETE triggers abort), values in a redactable side table in the same db (SqliteSideStore, C3 SideStore). Store implements StateView/StateWriter: put -> WriteEntry before/after ver+hash, ver+1 per object, tombstones (re-create continues counter), restore(expect=head) = new version by ks.recovery (StaleExpect / RedactedValue), visible_to=seq for M11c, history/heads/value_at. put refuses outside a caller-owned BEGIN IMMEDIATE txn, seq behind store, or 2nd write to an object at one seq; Store.txn() helper. FieldSchema (fields.py) is the B3-04 seam: sensitive-key rejection, field obj check, write_row splits rows and writes only changed objects (field-only edit keeps row ver; row create/delete writes/tombstones field objects). DB 0600. Completed interrupted attempt: lint, re-put of a redacted value re-populates side entry. tests/state: 20 passed; full suite 441 passed.

log.msg: Dependency on B3-01 is soft: the store needs no 1.2 field, start D1 on contracts 1.1.0 (keeps the critical path off the contracts bump)
